Name: Skill Experience Control (EXP control)
Author: MoonSlime
Description:
Very simple mod. It creates a config.json file when you boot up the game that lets you control the exp values of each of the vanilla skills. 

If you have mod config menu, you can do it in game.



[s]I miss margo and not being able to adjust exp values through the margo menu is why I made this mod.[/s]

Downloads.Description:
make sure to clear out old files when updating!

Allows for storing decimal places for exp values.

Manifest.Name: Exp Control
Manifest.Description: Allows increasing or decreasing how much exp you get for base skills.
